# Capacity Development Activities

The Secretariat's capacity development activities are guided by requests for technical assistance from CPCs, priorities identified through the review of national data submissions, and recommendations arising from IOTC scientific meetings. These activities aim to strengthen national capacities for fisheries data collection, processing and reporting, and to support the implementation of IOTC reporting requirements.

During 2026, the Data Section conducted five in-country technical assistance missions and organised three data-related workshops, including one online seminar. It also participated in external technical meetings and workshops. A consolidated record of these activities, including dates, counterparts and short descriptions, is provided in **[Appendix I](#AppDataSectionActivities)**.

Detailed descriptions of the in-country missions and workshops and meetings are provided in **[Appendix II](#missions)** and **[Appendix III](#workshops)**, respectively.
